set.body:
Problem: dataset currently depends on bids and the JVM LNA adapter imports BidsJson/BidsTable, while the module map says BIDS should stay standalone. LnaDatasetQuery also lacks run/acq/desc and filters by filename substring.

Work: choose and implement the correct boundary: either move BIDS table/entity parsing into a narrow adapter layer or intentionally update the architecture. Replace substring lookup with parsed entities for subject/session/task/run/acq/space/desc where relevant, and keep archive decoding behind DatasetBackend/LatentResponseDatasetBackend contracts.

Acceptance: build.sbt and docs/module-relations.md agree with the implemented boundary; LNA lookup handles multiple runs without ambiguity; query errors are typed and specific; JVM LNA tests cover run/acq/desc collisions and exact entity matching.
set.title: Dataset IO: repair BIDS/LNA adapter boundary and parsed queries
